title: OpenAI Codex CLI
notes: A starting point from the docs, not yet run here: prove it with `fleet harness check codex --live`. `codex exec -` reads the prompt from stdin; the session id is the thread_id of the thread.started event; resume inherits the sandbox of the first turn, so whether it takes --add-dir again is to be checked. workspace-write keeps the network off, which also keeps `git push` from working.
